description: Canonical synthetic QA corpus manifest (Research Spine provisional-only). Every slice is small, license-clean, and tracked. Seeding goes through the real evidence-unit path; every seeded artifact carries is_qa_provisional=true and can never reach accepted/reportable states.

sources.text: Synthetic coding task: participant describes a feature request with ambiguous acceptance criteria and a single edge case.
Synthetic usability note: the reviewer flags a missing success state and a vague error message.
Synthetic synthesis input: two evidence units that partially overlap and cite different source spans.
Synthetic synthesis input: one unit with low consensus that must enter reconciliation.
Synthetic low-consensus case: coders disagree on the primary theme and the disagreement must be preserved.
